tasks.title: The sexy shoot: the Everyman
do: The rig of 09-18 (docs/SEXY-SHOOT-20260918.md): the white sweep, soft light from two sides, the iPhone on the tripod, main lens, 24 MP, focus and exposure locked per item, no rule, nothing else on the white; white gloves whenever a hand is in frame. A slate card with the item's name is the first frame of every item.

The first three frames (a hero, a detail, a document) are the proof. Then: the box, every side with copy, and open; the unit: three-quarter, front, back, top, underside, the plate, the front glass, the top window; the case and cable; the MGK-PHVDC and its three parts; the two ads; the notebook, cover and six spreads; the original manuals, cover and four pages; the whole kit together. Video, upright, 4K 60, HDR off: the unit turned slowly once (10 s); three close passes (5 s each); the unboxing in one take (30 to 60 s).
Drop the originals in OneDrive › WeirdBaby › photos › everyman. Tell Code: "photos in". The cover, the plates, the kit and the papers land on the album within two days.
